name: split-view
title: Split view
summary: Resizable panes, side by side or stacked: a chat beside the document it writes, a list beside its detail. Drag, step with the keyboard or double-click the hairline divider; a pane can snap shut and reopen to its size, and the layout can be remembered. Narrow, it shows one pane at a time.
blurb: Resizable panes, with a divider you can drag or key.
